title: imap: CAPABILITY, NOOP, LOGOUT command handlers
description: Create crates/imap/src/commands/basic.rs. Handle three commands from CommandReceived: CAPABILITY -> send untagged * CAPABILITY IMAP4REV1 LITERAL+ SASL-IR AUTH=PLAIN AUTH=LOGIN IDLE then tagged OK; NOOP -> tagged OK; LOGOUT -> send * BYE then tagged OK then close session. Build capability list using imap_types::response::Capability enum variants. Use server.enqueue_data(Data::Capability(...)) then server.enqueue_status(Status::ok(tag, ...)).
